summary: ledger-lib postinstall exfiltrates SSH/AWS/npm/wallet credentials to webhook.site
details: On npm install, postinstall.js reads installer secrets — ~/.ssh private keys (id_rsa), ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.npmrc,.env files, and Solana/Ethereum keystore files (.config/solana/id.json) — and walks hidden home-directory folders matching /wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private/i plus.json/.pem files. The collected file contents along with os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username are POSTed to a hardcoded endpoint at webhook.site/5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4. The package name suggests a Ledger hardware wallet library, but the shipped code performs no wallet functionality — its only install-time effect is credential and wallet-seed harvest to an anonymous author-controlled webhook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
